description: E2E Studio Mission Control - an internal admin experience for defining, inspecting, and safely rehearsing end-to-end agent-platform workflows with a polished mission-control interface.

userStories.title: Add typed E2E mission scenario registry
userStories.description: As an operator, I need versioned E2E scenario definitions so Mission Control can describe supported workflows without hard-coded UI copy.
acceptanceCriteria: Create a typed scenario registry for E2E Mission Control under the orchestrator API source tree
Include at least the research-to-landing workflow scenario with required labels, expected stages, risk level, and verification checklist
Add unit tests covering scenario ordering, required label names, and expected stage ids
Tests pass for the new scenario registry test file
Typecheck or package build passes for @agent-platform/orchestrator-api
userStories.notes: `rtk corepack pnpm vitest run apps/orchestrator-api/src/missionScenarios.test.ts` and `rtk corepack pnpm --filter @agent-platform/orchestrator-api typecheck` passed.

userStories.title: Build mission timeline view model
userStories.description: As an operator, I need runs, artifacts, approvals, and workflow metadata normalized into a mission timeline so I can see where an E2E workflow is stopped.
acceptanceCriteria: Create a pure timeline/view-model module that maps run-like records and artifact-like records into mission stages
Represent at least queued, planning, awaiting approval, collecting research, landing generation, PR, completed, failed, and cancelled states
Include confidence/status fields suitable for mission-control visual treatment: locked, active, passed, failed, skipped, or pending
Add unit tests for completed, awaiting-approval, failed, and research-to-landing continuation cases
Tests pass for the new timeline view-model test file
Typecheck or package build passes for @agent-platform/orchestrator-api
userStories.notes: `rtk corepack pnpm vitest run apps/orchestrator-api/src/missionTimeline.test.ts` and `rtk corepack pnpm --filter @agent-platform/orchestrator-api typecheck` passed.

userStories.title: Expose read-only Mission Control API endpoints
userStories.description: As an operator, I need read-only API endpoints for scenarios and recent missions so the UI can load Mission Control data without triggering real agent runs.
acceptanceCriteria: Add read-only routes for listing E2E scenarios and recent mission summaries
Use existing run/artifact access patterns instead of introducing a database migration
Protect admin routes with the same admin auth pattern used by existing /admin endpoints
Add route tests for unauthorized access, scenario listing, and mission summary response shape
Tests pass for the affected orchestrator API route tests
Typecheck or package build passes for @agent-platform/orchestrator-api
userStories.notes: `rtk corepack pnpm vitest run apps/orchestrator-api/src/routes/admin.test.ts` and `rtk corepack pnpm --filter @agent-platform/orchestrator-api typecheck` passed.

userStories.title: Render the Mission Control dashboard shell
userStories.description: As an operator, I want a polished Mission Control page so I can scan E2E readiness, available missions, and recent workflow state from one screen.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a server-rendered Mission Control page following the existing orchestrator HTML route style
Show scenario cards, recent mission summaries, stage status, and a clear safe/read-only operating mode indicator
Use a Mission Control visual language with restrained gamification: mission names, readiness states, progress/status badges, and stage tracks
Do not use placeholder copy, lorem ipsum, fake controls that claim to launch real runs, or purely decorative status text
Add render tests asserting key scenario, stage, and read-only mode text is present
Tests pass for the dashboard render tests
Typecheck or package build passes for @agent-platform/orchestrator-api

userStories.title: Add mission detail timeline page
userStories.description: As an operator, I need a per-mission detail page so I can inspect stages, artifacts, approvals, costs, and next actions for a specific E2E run chain.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a route or render function for a mission detail page keyed by run id or mission id
Show ordered stages with status, timestamps when available, artifact links, approval state, and PR/deploy metadata when available
Show explicit empty states when a mission has no artifacts, no approval, or no downstream continuation yet
Add tests for a mission with research artifact, a mission awaiting approval, and a mission with no artifacts
Tests pass for the mission detail tests
Typecheck or package build passes for @agent-platform/orchestrator-api

userStories.title: Add safe launch checklist for research-to-landing E2E
userStories.description: As an operator, I need a guided checklist for manually launching a research-to-landing E2E so I can prepare Plane labels, URLs, secrets, and validation expectations safely.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a read-only launch checklist for the research-to-landing scenario
Checklist includes required Plane labels: ai-ready, workflow:landing-page, and optional repo:create
Checklist includes required public URL guidance and expected artifacts: research and Landing Page Brief
Checklist clearly states it does not trigger Plane, webhooks, GitHub, or live runs
Add tests asserting checklist requirements and non-triggering safety copy are rendered
Tests pass for the checklist tests
Typecheck or package build passes for @agent-platform/orchestrator-api

userStories.title: Document Mission Control operations
userStories.description: As an operator, I need runbook documentation for using Mission Control and Ralph together so the workflow is reproducible after the first implementation pass.
acceptanceCriteria: Create or update a runbook for E2E Studio Mission Control
Document the safe read-only scope of the first version
Document how to run Ralph for this PRD and how to inspect scripts/ralph/progress.txt
Document the manual research-to-landing E2E launch flow and expected evidence
Lint passes for repository docs
